2021.11.11
现版本平衡已经优化，内容丰富，可以入坑。爷青回
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I love this game very much, and that's the reason why I decide to post this negative review. 

I purchased DRG supporter edition at March 4th 2018. At that time, the game was at its very first version. Since DRG lunched, developers keep updating, which is fabulous. We've got more weapons, more equipment, more weapon modifications, badass weapon skins and more elite enemies. However, one problem occurs: enemies become stronger while players are actually weaker.

Although players now have more Grenades to choose and Overclocks, players’ overall damage output is lower. Engineer's Sentry and SMG deal less damage. Gunner's Shield Generator added cool down and Revolver deals less damage. Less C4 Driller can carry (of course you can carry the same amount as the previous version, but much less damage for each of them). Scout now deals much less damage whatever weapon you choose.


And yet, enemies are reinforcing. Dreadnaughts are legendarily reinforced with regenerative armor. More and more elite enemy subspecies. I do not have to name all of them.

Yes, players need more enemies and challenges. But there is no point to weaken players. And now, update 28 completely ruined Iron Will, which is one of the most popular perks for all players. Developers, ask yourself: is it necessary to weaken player while making enemies stronger? For me, DRG was once a very fun game especially coop with friends. And now, it gradually becomes a hardcore game.

英文写给开发看的，爱看不看随便吧。

发售不久最初版本就买的游戏。之前一直更新得很不错。一开始没中文的，后来也加入了中文。新武器，新改造，新皮肤，还有新敌人。但是问题来了：敌人越来越强而相比之下玩家却越来越弱。

虽然现在加入了超载配件，但是加强的那点远远不够。工程的枪塔和SMG砍，枪手的盾和左轮砍，钻机C4砍，侦查全面砍。

相比之下，敌人疯狂加强。无畏虫史诗级buff再生皮，其他各种精英怪数不胜数。

玩家需要更丰富的游戏元素带来的挑战，但是完全没必要削弱玩家。更新28的重置天赋系统直接把钢铁意志砍成傻屌，按主动被动分技能，但实际上有用的技能能带的却还变少了。非要把一个欢乐向的合作游戏做成硬核肝游。
非常棒的游戏，买了绝对不亏，和朋友联机最佳，单撸也可以，打折的时候可以推荐基友入坑一波，这次的新枪也诚意满满~
真的垃圾游戏，玩着好好的突然被封号了

当初买之前，我没有想到过高级版的黄金矿工可以这么有意思。
